authoring_notes: Authored from the AWS AIP-C01 standard exam guide and official service documentation. Explanations are paraphrased; questions are original exam-style practice, not recalled exam content.

modules.title: Task 2.1: Implement agentic AI solutions and tool integrations.

nodes.title: Build autonomous and multi-agent systems with memory

modules.title: Task 2.3: Design and implement enterprise integration architectures.
